title: The Happyforms Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Happyforms Pro plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'happyforms_client_referer' parameter. This vulnerability affects all versions up to and including 1.38.9 and allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users view the affected pages.
